zoe (Docs): Heads-up: opened PR for release notes and changelog: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/511. Draft includes: routing telemetry blurb, canary latency known-issue, updated Python streaming snippet, and i18n keys. Please review.

carlos (PM): Order: public blurb, known-issue + repro, snippet + compatibility note, i18n keys, legal wording.

prakash (Eng): Minimal repro for canary latency: deploy canary at 10%, run 180 QPS with 95th token lengths ~400 for 3m. Canary p95 rises ~35% due to KV cache churn. Mitigation: pin to dedicated or pre-warm prefixes. I'll link runbook.

abby (DevEx): New streaming snippet (SDK >=2.1.0):
```python
resp = client.chat.stream(model='kestrel-v1', input=prompt)
for chunk in resp:
    sys.stdout.write(chunk.delta)
```
Legacy fallback for <=2.0.x included below. Add "Requires SDK >= 2.1.0" note.

marta (L10N): Please list exact strings and file paths. Need keys today to queue translations.

legal-bot: Recommended telemetry copy: "We collect aggregated routing telemetry (latency and error rates) to improve service quality. No user text payloads are stored."
